items.title: AI unlocks Gödel's notebooks, said to contain hundreds of proved theorems

extra.evidence: Kurt Gödel left 1,009 pages of densely written text – much of it in an obsolete shorthand – which is now said to contain hundreds of proved theorems The Austrian logician Kurt Gödel was one of the most original thinkers of the 20th century. His two incompleteness theorems , published in 1931, transformed mathematics and paved the way for the digital age. After his seminal results of the 1930s, Gödel published only a few papers. His unpublished work, however, runs to tens of thousands of pages, and is of great interest to historians of science. Since 2017, the Finnish logician Jan von Plato has led a project at Helsinki University to understand the contents of 16 notebooks that Gödel wrote in the early 1940s. items.title: 「史上最严」湿实验预测基准发布！推理拉满、算力翻5倍也白搭
items.summary: 斯坦福、哈佛、康奈尔……十余家顶尖团队齐坐一桌了

extra.evidence: 斯坦福、哈佛、康奈尔……十余家顶尖团队齐坐一桌了 这回不刷题了，就直接给AI一组实验条件，让它 自己研究、提前猜真实湿实验的结果 …… 比如，同一个反应换几种条件，哪种能得到更多目标产物？一批抗体变体，哪个表达量更高？ 这两年， AI for Science 的方式越来越深入，AI已经能自主查文献、用软件，为完成一项分析任务连续做上几小时也不在话下。 它需要AI理解实验目标，并从已有知识中挖掘出相关机制，才能更好地帮助研究人员筛选值得进一步探索的研究方向。 UniPat AI牵头推出的新基准 Science Prediction Universe （简称SPU），便敏锐地察觉到这一点。 116个任务，4207个湿实验，覆盖化学、材料科学、生物和医学，基准顾问与湿实验合作成员也来自斯坦福、康奈尔、哈佛等高校，以及业内前沿科研机构和生物技术公司。 模型践行每次工作8小时制，配有一块H20，然后自主决定怎样利用检索与计算资源形成实验预测。 即使强如Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra，数据上 距离真正能实现预测还都很遥远 。。。 科学史上有过很多这样的时刻，一个判断在实验之前被给出，然后交给过程去裁决，对了就留下，错了就推翻。 毕竟光一次湿实验，做化学的要配试剂、设定反应条件，再分离产物；做生物的也要经过漫长的蛋白表达……时间成本、工具费用本身就价格不菲，结果不理想还得反反复复做好几轮。 只不过区别在于，过去这件事纯靠科学家自己，现在到了AI时代，模型也需要有这项能力，并且还需要一张能为之打分的试卷。 现有的基准还无法完全覆盖 ，比如BrainBench让模型直接判断实验结果，ScienceAgentBench侧重在已有数据上完成分析，Terminal-Bench 4.0和Long-Horizon-TB这类长程任务基准，则主要用预设测试检查任务产物。 它更强调把AI自主研究…

items.title: After 600 experiments, here's what I discovered about JEPA world models

extra.evidence: There's a big debate in AI right now about what a world model should be. Most of the attention goes to generative world models, which predict the future by generating it, usually in pixels. Solving long-horizon tasks without any extra training The proposed alternative is JEPA, the joint-embedding predictive architecture. It has three parts: an encoder, a predictor and a planner. The encoder turns each frame of observation into a learned embedding, a compact vector that describes the scene. The predictor takes that embedding plus an action and predicts the embedding of the next frame. The planner then tries hundreds of action sequences inside the predictor and picks the one whose predicted end state lands closest to the embedding of the goal. items.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
items.summary: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain. Large language models (LLMs) possess physical knowledge, but struggle to reliably guide video generation models in producing their training videos. We present PhysLoop, a unified harness designed to support physically grounded self-improvement in video generation models. The harness guides and constrains LLMs throughout video generation, selection, and correction, distilling their physical knowledge into physically consistent videos. The framework supports controllable training-data construction and inference-time video repair. By identifying and correcting failures, PhysLoop marks a key milestone toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video generation models with limited human intervention. We release 100K videos spanning diverse, realistic indoor and outdoor scenes, along with generation tools and two evaluation datasets: PhysLoop-Gen and PhysLoop-Repair. We evaluate controllable generation and localized repair on these datasets, respectively, and assess physical behavior on the external Physics-IQ Verified benchmark.
items.title_zh: PhysLoop：利用大模型物理感知实现视频生成模型自我改进
items.summary_zh: 视频生成模型难以处理物理动态和因果一致性。PhysLoop 框架利用大模型的物理知识，通过引导和约束生成过程，将物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频。该方法实现了可控训练数据构建和推理时视频修复。

items.title: Kezek: Splitting Mono Two-Person Conversations into Per-Speaker Tracks for Full-Duplex Dialogue Data
items.summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models learn turn-taking, overlaps and backchannels from conversations recorded with one channel per speaker, but most available conversational audio is a single mono mix. We present Kezek, a model that turns a mono recording of exactly two people into one track per person with the original length and timing; overlaps and short replies ("yeah", "mm-hm") stay on the track of the person who said them. Kezek decides who speaks when and who is who once for the whole recording (stage 1: a two-voice activity model guided by a speaker fingerprint trained to be insensitive to phase), and a conditioned time-domain separator only carries out that decision (stage 2), with outputs that always sum to the input. Standard separation metrics miss the failures that matter for dialogue data, so we report short-reply retention, leakage onto the other person's solo, channel swaps and coverage. Against the open pipeline pyannote -> DialogueSidon on the same recordings, Kezek keeps more short replies (0.83 vs. 0.69 on Open Yap test; 0.80 vs. 0.71 over the other's speech on unseen telephone speech from CallHome English), mostly because it returns the whole recording while the external pipeline drops part of it (on the audio both return, reply retention is about the same: 0.859 vs. 0.865 on Open Yap); it also leaks less, swaps channels less often, and runs 4-5 times faster (about 230 hours of audio per GPU-hour). We also report negative results and an ideal-mask ceiling…

items.title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Failure Taxonomy of Streaming Dictation ASR
items.summary: Speech recognition (ASR) systems are usually compared by word error rate (WER) on recorded files, after punctuation, capital letters and number format are removed. In dictation, the audio is streamed live and the text goes into the user's message as written, so what matters is which mistakes the user has to fix. The test set, streamed to eleven ASR systems, comprises 106 scripted English dictations from one speaker (read in a quiet room, with a fan on, and whispered), 20 clips in each of eleven other language and dialect sets, and 400 recordings that join clips in two languages. Every error was sorted by a fixed rule into four levels: recognition, output formatting, language handling and, for the self-hosted models, audio dropped before the model. Systems with similar WER failed in different ways. Zoom Scribe and OpenAI's GPT-Live-Transcribe have almost the same WER on quiet English (7.4% and 7.3%), but 34.7% and 8.8% on whispered English. Zoom and both AssemblyAI models left out 26-28% of whispered words, and still 21-26% with their end-of-turn detection relaxed or off; seven other systems left out at most 3%. Qwen3-ASR's 32% came from the speech detection in our own deployment (6% when relaxed). Across 107 EARS speakers, the same four systems lost 7-31% of whispered words, while six others lost under 2%. With only English selected, Gemini, Deepgram and our self-hosted Whisper lost the non-English part of a two-language recording in 86-99% of recordings, against 33-46% with…
items.title_zh: 超越词错误率：流式听写 ASR 失败分类法
items.summary_zh: 流式听写 ASR 系统的评估不应仅依赖词错误率。本文提出一种失败分类法，将错误分为识别、输出格式、语言处理等四个级别。实验发现，不同 WER 的系统在处理低信噪比或多语言时失败方式各异。

items.title: Towards Green Text Generation: Memory-Based Speculative Decoding
items.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates text generation with large language models by letting a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large verifier checks in a single forward pass. We introduce Olifant, a draft model built on a memory-based classifier. It predicts the next token from a four-token window in under 0.3 ms on CPU, requiring no GPU, no backpropagation, and no accelerator memory. We measure throughput and energy under two verifier regimes on consumer hardware. Without a KV cache, drafting is nearly free: a domain-matched Olifant model reaches 38.1% acceptance on EU legal text, delivering 2.43x throughput and 2.51x lower energy per token than the neural verifier model alone. With a KV-cached verifier, itself a ~10x energy saver, drafting costs matter: a TinyLlama draft model halves throughput and triples energy despite high acceptance, whereas Olifant still yields 1.25x throughput and the lowest energy in the study (93 J per 100 tokens, 14x below the uncached baseline). We further show that KV caching decouples time from energy: verification of longer drafts raises power draw, shifting the energy-optimal draft length below the speed-optimal one. Speculative decoding is not dead in the age of fast verifiers, provided drafting is nearly free.
items.summary_zh: 推测解码通过廉价草稿模型加速大模型生成。Olifant 是一个基于内存分类器的草稿模型，在 CPU 上预测下一个 token。实验显示，在无 KV 缓存时，Olifant 能显著提升吞吐量和降低能耗。

items.title: SignRot: LLM Quantization with Massive Outlier-Aware Sign-Adjusted Rotation
items.summary: While quantization compresses LLMs and accelerates inference, outlier activations impede efficient low-bit representation. In particular, massive outliers cause substantial performance degradation. Although rotation-based methods that rely on randomized Hadamard transforms for online inference aim to mitigate this, they can produce fragmented distributions with empty bins when a massive outlier dominates a token's activation. This fragmentation severely undermines uniform quantization performance. Moreover, massive outliers concentrate in the down-projection input, where the preceding nonlinearity requires the rotation to be applied at inference time. This constraint prevents training-based approaches such as SpinQuant from learning the online rotation at this position, as a learned dense matrix cannot use the Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform and would require a full matrix multiplication during inference. To address this, we propose SignRot (Sign-adjusted Rotation), which identifies massive outlier channels and constructs a sign adjustment vector that unifies the signs of the corresponding Hadamard row, collapsing the bimodal distribution into a unimodal profile amenable to quantization. Since the aligned outlier shifts the activation mean away from zero, we pair SignRot with asymmetric activation quantization, whose zero-point absorbs this shift. As a lightweight, drop-in improvement compatible with any Hadamard-based quantization method, SignRot requires only a single calibr…
items.title_zh: SignRot：大规模异常值感知的符号调整旋转量化
items.summary_zh: LLM 量化中的异常值会降低性能。SignRot 方法通过识别异常通道并构建符号调整向量，将双峰分布压缩为单峰分布，使其适合量化。该方法与不对称激活量化结合，实现了轻量级的量化改进。

entries.headline: CVPR 2027 论文截稿
entries.body: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition（CVPR 2027，CCF-A 类，人工智能）论文提交截止时间为北京时间11月17日 19:59，摘要截止时间为11月11日 19:59。会议将于 June 22-25, 2027 在 Seattle, WA, United States 举行。

fca2b3d26517.headline: AI 解锁哥德尔手稿
fca2b3d26517.body: AI 帮助解读库尔特·哥德尔留下的 1,009 页手稿，其中包含数百个已证明的定理。

d9ccfe9c1761.headline: 斯坦福等团队发布SPU湿实验预测基准
d9ccfe9c1761.body: 斯坦福等团队推出Science Prediction Universe基准，测试AI在化学、生物等领域的湿实验预测能力。

4c23f242cac6.headline: Claude完成费马大定理形式化证明
4c23f242cac6.body: Claude Fable 5.2在30小时内完成费马大定理的形式化证明，并发现13年前证明中的错误。

1bb0b89509dd.headline: 600 次实验发现 JEPA 世界模型
1bb0b89509dd.body: JEPA 是一种联合嵌入预测架构，用于解决长时域任务，包含编码器、预测器和规划器。

ba1e55febf6c.headline: Nvidia CEO辞职影响开源AI生态
ba1e55febf6c.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang辞职可能影响美国开源AI模型生态的发展。

be02ca9585a6.headline: OpenAI Shield助力IT技术人员交接工作
be02ca9585a6.body: Shield利用OpenAI帮助IT技术人员在遗留门户系统中交接工作。

3d2092dbd070.headline: Anthropic CEO称未来一年充满不确定性
3d2092dbd070.body: Anthropic CEO Amodei在IPO前表示，购买算力是公司面临的最深商业困境。

38e1f2be4cd0.headline: 李飞飞世界模型Atlas正式开放
38e1f2be4cd0.body: 李飞飞创办的World Labs正式开放世界模型Atlas，用户可通过提示词生成3D场景。

ab46b4892965.headline: ai--manus2.0：通用 AI Agent 系统
ab46b4892965.body: AI Manus 是一个通用 AI Agent 系统，支持在沙盒环境中运行各种工具和操作。

d0265fe5de40.headline: GitHub Copilot app：agent 原生桌面体验
d0265fe5de40.body: GitHub Copilot app 是一个面向 GitHub 仓库的 agent 原生桌面体验，用于查找、运行、引导和落地软件工作。

92baf8e671f4.headline: LangChain博客讨论Goal Engineering
92baf8e671f4.body: LangChain博客指出智能体承担开放性目标并驱动其完成是未来发展方向。

a866b09b0052.headline: LLMs-from-scratch：从零实现 LLM
a866b09b0052.body: 使用 PyTorch 从零开始逐步实现一个类似 ChatGPT 的 LLM。

4c6326b8d7aa.headline: claude-trading-skills：交易技能
4c6326b8d7aa.body: Claude Code 技能，用于股票投资者和交易者的市场分析、技术图表、经济日历、筛选器和交易策略开发。

12221ab3bb24.headline: univer：AI 办公套件 SDK
12221ab3bb24.body: Univer Office SDK 用于构建自己的 AI 办公套件，支持编辑、计算、协作和文件处理。

81824d05a098.headline: phimint v0.10.0发布
81824d05a098.body: phimint v0.10.0发布，Rust编写的终端AI编码agent能自主处理终端交互。

eb0a8524a4c8.headline: PhysLoop：物理感知视频生成
eb0a8524a4c8.body: PhysLoop 框架利用大模型的物理知识，通过引导和约束生成过程，将物理知识蒸馏为物理一致的视频。

31b8ebf90bca.headline: Kezek：双声道对话音频分离
31b8ebf90bca.body: Kezek 模型将双人的单声道录音分离为每人一条轨道，保留重叠和简短回复。

e762953b67d6.headline: 流式听写 ASR 失败分类法
e762953b67d6.body: 流式听写 ASR 系统的评估不应仅依赖词错误率，本文提出一种失败分类法，将错误分为识别、输出格式、语言处理等四个级别。

d7bc8e598342.headline: 基于内存分类器的推测解码加速生成
d7bc8e598342.body: Olifant 是一个基于内存分类器的草稿模型，在 CPU 上预测下一个 token，实验显示其在无 KV 缓存时能显著提升吞吐量和降低能耗。

37f5ee6937fa.headline: SignRot 量化方法改进 LLM
37f5ee6937fa.body: SignRot 方法通过识别异常通道并构建符号调整向量，将双峰分布压缩为单峰分布，与不对称激活量化结合实现了轻量级的量化改进。
